selection_goal: Non-redundant publication evidence selection from cryptographically locked upstream artifacts.
integrity_verification_policy: Artifact integrity may be verified by an exact trusted path-to-SHA mapping or by an exact content SHA referenced through the recursively trusted upstream manifest chain.

non_redundancy_policy.main_domain_generalization: Strict shared-8-class comparison is the main figure. The overall comparison is supplementary because strict class matching is methodologically cleaner.
non_redundancy_policy.main_classwise_degradation: The shared-class F1 comparison is retained. A second F1-drop-only graphic is unnecessary in the main manuscript.
non_redundancy_policy.main_calibration: The reliability diagram is retained as the main calibration figure. Accuracy-versus-confidence is supporting supplementary evidence.
non_redundancy_policy.main_xai_semantic_summary: The combined External Correct-versus-Wrong XAI comparison is retained rather than separate main figures for symptom alignment and background attention.
non_redundancy_policy.qualitative_xai: Representative predicted-versus-true Grad-CAM++ error panels are retained because image-level spatial evidence cannot be replaced by aggregate statistics.
non_redundancy_policy.roc_pr: ROC and PR curves are supplementary. External classification metrics and the confusion matrix are more directly informative for the study objective.
